axes.label: Friendly Magic, Curse, and Poison removal

notes: Nature's Cure has broad healer dispel coverage and area-control tools can stop eligible packs or help the tank kite.
The source explicitly leaves dungeon-specific tips pending, so the rating is toolkit coverage rather than a claimed authored mechanic recommendation.

recommendations: Typhoon and Incapacitating Roar can control multiple orbs, but both require talent access and Typhoon changes enemy positioning.
Contribute priority damage only when group healing permits.
High mobility and healing while moving make orb collection practical.
The guide recommends dispelling one application and healing the rest; additional group dispels can improve coverage.
